facts.label: Comparar e escolher o melhor
facts.sub: Use -er than para comparar e the -est para o melhor. Com adjetivos longos, use more e the most: more exciting, the most exciting.

facts.label: Mais ... que
facts.sub: Para adjetivos curtos, junte -er e use than: long, longer than; slow, slower than. Para adjetivos terminados em y, troque por -ier: funny, funnier. Good vira better.

facts.label: O mais
facts.sub: Para dizer o mais, use the + -est: the longest, the shortest, the best. Good vira the best e bad vira the worst. Use com in the club ou of the year.

items.s: We use -er to compare short adjectives.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

We say more long. → Falso (We say longer.)
Good becomes better. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a small café in Perth. Six chairs stand in a circle. Uri puts a pile of books on the table. His friend Max comes in with a novel. The book club starts at seven. They talk about books first.
“Hi, Max! Which book did you read this month?” says Uri. “I read a mystery novel. It’s longer than my last book.” says Max. “Is it better than your last book?” says Uri.
